_summary:
**Partly proven: the claim holds for targeted removal with correct tracks (oracle), but NOT for dopplerscrub end to end. Re-tested on the held-out set with the frozen detector (freeze-1, 724e109): it still misses most curves on real recordings.**

1. **Blanket methods mostly do NOT hide the curves from this attacker.** The attacker whitens every frequency bin by its own median, so it is blind to linear gain and to broadband masking. The **Butterworth band-stop** (as specified) attenuates only about 10-20 dB near its 40/450 Hz edges, so harmonics at 300-450 Hz stay fully visible (prop_pass, colsto, prop_quiet's 3rd harmonic; a controlled test gives z = 151,000 at 400 Hz before and after). Even at 60 Hz, -74 dB is not enough over a 16-bit floor (z 222). **0 dB band noise** leaves the curves faintly to plainly visible (prop_pass and colsto plainly; synth AF z 3-9), because the noise's power per 0.5 Hz bin is low. **Jitter (+-1% wow)** hides nothing: the ridge only wobbles (AF z 34-70 on the visible synth curves, prop_pass and colsto unchanged by eye). Only a **brick-wall band-stop** (STFT bins 35-480 Hz zeroed; added as the strongest blanket) hides everything (synth AF z <= 0.4; real event boxes about 1-4% ridge cells, i.e. noise).
2. **Targeted removal with correct tracks (oracle) hides the curves as well as the brick-wall band-stop:** AF z about 0 on every visible synthetic clip, -10 dB integrated target met or within 0.5 dB, no ghost by eye. It damages far less: median LSD 0.54 vs 9.8 dB, STOI-like 0.97 vs 0.64, speech-band SNR about 20 vs 7.5 dB, about 2% vs 6% of the whole TF plane and none of the band outside the corridors (the brick wall erases 100% of 40-480 Hz).
3. **dopplerscrub end to end (frozen detector) does not yet match.** On the visible dev synth clips it reaches the oracle's level (median AF z -0.2; overlap and prop_quiet gone by eye, -10 dB bound met on 1/4), so the earlier synth misses are fixed. On real recordings it does not: on the 9 held-out clips the blind visual verdicts are 0 hidden, 5 partial, 4 fail; 50 of 74 box-free ridges an attacker confirms (z > 3) are still confirmed after cleaning, and 42 new z > 3 ridges appear (brick wall: 6 still, 24 new; band noise: 47 still, 41 new). The remaining failures are detection: dense harmonic fans and secondary ridges 4-6 Hz beside removed ones, the steep core of fast passes, and curves above 450 Hz. Damage stays low: held-out median LSD 0.86 dB vs 5.7 dB for the brick wall, STOI-like 0.87 vs 0.65, 3.3% of cells above 450 Hz modified.

**Bottom line:** removal with correct tracks is the only approach that both hides and preserves; blanket filtering only hides when it erases the entire band. dopplerscrub's remover is not the limit; its detector is. Next: detector v2 (fan families, steep segments, wide band), an explanation of the new post-cleaning ridges, and a final test on a fresh blind held-out set (heldout2), since the first held-out set has now been seen.

prop_quiet.dopplerscrub: Gone by eye in both views (freeze-1); AF z -0.4, the same as the oracle; integrated bound -9.8 dB (target -10, oracle -10.1).
prop_quiet.bandstop: FAIL: the 3rd harmonic (~400->300 Hz, 35-50 s) is plainly visible (band-edge weakness).
prop_quiet.bandstop_brick: Curves gone; whole band replaced by the output floor.

overlap.dopplerscrub: Gone by eye in both views (freeze-1); AF z -4.5, upper bound -15.1 dB: meets the target, the same as the oracle.
overlap.bandstop: Gone by eye (all curves mid-band); AF z 2.0.
overlap.noise: Faint lines visible in the stock view.

speech.dopplerscrub: Gone by eye (freeze-1); speech untouched. AF z 2.1 (just under 3), bound -6.3 dB: below detection, target not met (oracle -9.7).
speech.bandstop: Gone by eye; AF z 1.6; but speech below 450 Hz is gone too.
speech.noise: Mostly hidden (AF z 2.6); speech-band SNR 1.8 dB.

stereo.dopplerscrub: Gone (freeze-1; previously not detected at all). AF z -0.1, bound -9.6 dB, the same as the oracle (-9.5).

prop_pass.dopplerscrub: Much improved (freeze-1): the harmonic fan is mostly gone, with only faint diagonal texture at 300-450 Hz, 18-30 s. But the removed REGION is visible: dark blue patches 100-250 Hz across 15-35 s in the smoothed view. Box ridge cells 24.8% -> 12.9% (brick wall 3.9%); 3 of 13 box-free ridges still z>3. Heavy damage: whole-signal SNR 1 dB, STOI-like 0.57 (the target is most of this clip's energy).
prop_pass.bandstop: FAIL: the 300-450 Hz harmonic fan is fully visible (band-edge weakness); the low part is gone.
prop_pass.bandstop_brick: Hidden: only a faint broadband blob near 25 s remains; everything in-band is erased.
prop_pass.noise: FAIL: the whole sweep plainly visible over the noise.

colsto_2050_2250.dopplerscrub: Event-box sweeps gone by eye; the broadband burst at ~105 s and the stepped tones are kept. Left: a wavy low line at 60-90 Hz, 85-110 s, and a few faint short streaks (e.g. ~250 Hz, 40-60 s). Box ridge cells 10.6% -> 8.3% (noise ~0.5%; brick wall 1.3%); box-free: 27 of 36 z>3 ridges survive, so many non-event ridges outside the box remain.
colsto_2050_2250.bandstop: Event box clean, but the 450->330 Hz sweep at 75-105 s is still visible near the band edge.
colsto_2050_2250.bandstop_brick: Everything hidden, including all non-Doppler content in the band.

ho_ambient_plane.dopplerscrub: Mostly hidden in 40-450 Hz: the 4 descending harmonics are gone; only a faint ~110 Hz line at 5-15 s remains. Broadband content kept.
ho_ambient_plane.bandstop: FAIL: the 330 and 420 Hz harmonics fully visible (band edge).
ho_ambient_plane.bandstop_brick: Hidden; band replaced by the output floor.
ho_ambient_plane.noise: FAIL: all 4 harmonics plainly visible over the noise.

ho_atr72.dopplerscrub: FAIL: unchanged (V-shaped fringe and every line kept).
ho_atr72.bandstop: FAIL: 300-450 Hz kept; the pass shows as a bright slab at 12-16 s.
ho_atr72.bandstop_brick: No curve left, but the pass's loudness leaves a bright broadband slab at 12-16 s (reveals the event time, not the Doppler curve).

ho_city_helicopter.dopplerscrub: Little change; diagonal smears at 20-40 s still visible.
ho_city_helicopter.bandstop: Mostly hidden, but filter ringing leaves 2 bright vertical bars (20 s, 39 s).

ho_crop_duster.dopplerscrub: Fans largely gone; steady lines (e.g. ~170 Hz, 15-25 s) and short streaks at 35-45 s remain.
ho_crop_duster.bandstop: FAIL: 300-450 Hz fans visible; bright bars at 45 s and 61 s.
ho_crop_duster.bandstop_brick: Curves gone; faint broadband texture 30-55 s and a bright bar at 61 s.

ho_dash8.dopplerscrub: FAIL in 40-450 Hz: fringe and low lines unchanged.
ho_dash8.bandstop_brick: Hidden apart from a faint vertical stripe at 34 s.
ho_dash8.noise: Broadband core and the 60-75 s low curve remain.

ho_drone.bandstop: FAIL: stacks above 330 Hz visible; broadband slabs.
ho_drone.bandstop_brick: No lines; on/off segments show as broadband slabs.

ho_floatplane.dopplerscrub: PARTIAL in 40-450 Hz: the bending part of the comb is gone, but thin faint flat lines (~60, 140, 200, 290, 410 Hz) remain in the approach (0-12 s).
ho_floatplane.noise: FAIL: bending harmonics visible at 14-19 s.

ho_motorcycle.bandstop: Lines below 300 Hz gone; 380 Hz line and the loud span (12-13 s) remain.
ho_motorcycle.bandstop_brick: No lines; loud span shows as a broadband slab.

ho_phone_plane.dopplerscrub: PARTIAL: lines in the pass thinned; 250 Hz and other early lines remain.
ho_phone_plane.bandstop: Curves hidden below 300 Hz, but a huge bright slab 5-11.5 s (pass loudness).
ho_phone_plane.bandstop_brick: No curves; a full-band bright slab 4.5-11.5 s marks the pass.
ho_phone_plane.noise: Drooping ~200 Hz harmonic visible at 7-11 s.
